subject: Lighthouse: May platform vitals & OKR pre-read
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.example>
To: irene.choi@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example, tessa.morgan@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lighthouse: May platform vitals & OKR pre-read

Team —

Attached is the May lighthouse packet (monthly_vitals). High level notes before you dig in: 
- Latency: P95 increased ~18% week-over-week on production (primarily for sequences >1k tokens).
- Cost: token spend up 12% due to longer sessions from a new enterprise customer sandbox.
- Uptime: 99.95% last 30 days — there was a scheduled infra maintenance on 5/04 that caused a short 3-min blip.
- Usage: active seats +22% MoM for the Dedicated tier.

Ask: please review the packet and flag any blockers for the 5/24 leadership pre-brief. I want owners and a proposed mitigation for the latency regression and one cost containment lever we can commit to for the next sprint.

Prelim owners suggested:
- Latency deep-dive & canary plan: Irene
- Cost variance + billing note: Marissa
- Ops readiness for QBR dashboard: Tessa

Irene — can you confirm whether the P95 spike looks like kernel-level regression vs. workload shift? Marissa — can you provide the cost variance by SKU (hosted vs. dedicated) and an initial ask for budget owners?

Attachment: 2029-05-monthly_vitals.pdf (summary, charts, appendix)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.example>
To: diego@redwood.example
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.example, tessa.morgan@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse: May platform vitals & OKR pre-read

Diego — thanks for the packet. Quick read-through and inline notes below.

Summary: initial look points to a workload-shift for the long-tail sequences (enterprise sandbox workloads) but there are two kernel call paths that amplified the P95 when the KV cache misses increased. I don't think it's a single regression in core FW — more of a trigger combination (workload + cache warmup).

Immediate actions I recommend:
- Canary extension: run 10% more traffic routed to the kv-cache-primed pool for 48 hours; measure P95 and tail. Owner: Irene (will need infra window).
- Mitigation: enable aggressive prefix caching for the sandbox customer for their sessions (config toggle). Owner: Irene + Solutions.
- Telemetry: add an hourly export of the per-model token latency to BigQuery (we currently only sample). Owner: Tessa (ops + telemetry).

I attached a short set of notes and the query I used (see bottom of message). Also request: Diego, can you attach the raw request-level latency CSV so I can run the tail analysis locally?

Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse: May platform vitals & OKR pre-read

Diego / team —

Thanks — attached is a short cost variance CSV (latency-breakdown-may.csv) showing hosted vs dedicated token spend and per-model cost deltas for May. Topline: the sandbox customer contributes ~37% of the extra token spend; 55% of that runs on hosted lanes.

Proposed finance guardrail for next sprint:
- Temporary quota cap at customer-profile on hosted lanes (2 weeks) + dedicated burst credits if they need elasticity. Owner: Marissa (will coordinate with Sales and Customer Success).
- Approve a one-time credit request if customer needs help migrating heavier workloads to dedicated pools. Owner: Diego + Sales.

I will also prepare a 1-slide cost summary for the 5/24 pre-brief — please confirm if you want us to show the cost delta as absolute dollars or % change (I prefer both, but if leadership wants one pick %).

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.example>

Subject: Re: Lighthouse: May platform vitals & OKR pre-read — action list and owners (final)

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Finalizing owners and commitments ahead of the 5/24 pre-brief: 

Action items (owners, due):
1) Canary extension and targeted prefix caching rollout — Irene — start 5/20, measure through 5/22. Deliverable: 48-hr canary run report (P50/P95/P99).
2) Cost variance & Acme row + one-slide cost summary — Marissa — deliver by 5/24 (format: absolute $ + % delta). Attachment: latency-breakdown-may.csv.
3) Telemetry export & dashboard tile for hourly per-model P95 — Tessa — PR for the hourly export by 5/21; dashboard update by 5/23.
4) Customer coordination (migration path + temporary cap) — Diego + Sales — propose cap by 5/21; migration plan draft by 5/28.

Status notes:
- Irene reported preliminary tail is driven mostly by cache misses; if the canary shows improvement we keep the prefix caching toggle live for the sandbox customer.
- Marissa's CSV confirms hosted lanes are the primary cost source for the spike; finance supports a time-limited quota approach.

Attachments: 2029-05-monthly_vitals.pdf (original), latency-breakdown-may.csv (cost breakdown supplied by Marissa).

I'll synthesize an exec 1-pager and circulate by 5/23 for review; Simon, we'll drop Acme's slide into that packet and share before 5/24.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
